title: Rito
description: A social bookmarking service built on the atproto. It provides a place to bookmark and share anything on the web, simply and with attention to detail.

aboutDetails.intro: Rito is an atproto-based social bookmarking service for saving useful links, adding your own context, and discovering what other people found worth keeping. Use your existing atproto account, including Bluesky accounts, without creating a separate Rito identity.

what.title: What Rito is for
what.description: Rito keeps links together with the context that makes them worth saving.

bookmark.title: Keep links
bookmark.description: Save public URLs such as articles, tools, videos, and app pages as bookmarks.

account.title: Use atproto
account.description: Sign in with an atproto account, including Bluesky accounts, without creating a separate Rito identity.

context.title: Add context
context.description: Comments and tags make it easier to remember why a link mattered when you return to it later.

myApps.title: My Apps
myApps.description: An atproto repository contains collections identified by NSIDs. My Apps turns those technical collection names into a visual catalog of services your account has records for.
myApps.collections: After you log in, Rito reads the collection list exposed by your PDS and groups related NSIDs by service.
myApps.catalog: When a matching service bookmark exists, Rito shows its website title, description, image, and tags, making unfamiliar collection names easier to understand.
myApps.boundary: My Apps is an informational catalog. Opening it does not install an app, grant new permissions, or prove that you currently use or endorse every listed service.

data.title: What happens to your data
data.description: Rito writes your bookmark records to your atproto Personal Data Server (PDS). Rito also indexes the information needed to provide public discovery, search, previews, categories, and safety filtering. Bookmarks intended for this social service may therefore be visible to other people; do not use Rito as a private vault for sensitive URLs or notes.
data.oauthDescription: Authentication happens directly on the connected PDS screen. Rito does not collect or store your password.
data.controlDescription: You keep control of your account. Before approval, you can review what Rito is allowed to read and write.

meta.title: How to use Rito | Save links with your Bluesky account

howToUseDetails.intro: Rito lets you sign in with an atproto account such as Bluesky and save web links with comments and tags.

what.title: What Rito is
what.description: Rito combines personal bookmark saving with social features for sharing interests with other users.
what.accountDescription: If you already have an atproto account, you can sign in without creating a separate Rito account.
what.shareDescription: Bookmarks registered in Rito are public on the internet. This open design helps people with shared interests exchange knowledge and find related information.

data.pdsDescription: Rito uses the atproto model, so bookmark data is saved to the Personal Data Server tied to your account. This keeps your records portable to compatible services.

workflow.title: How bookmarking works
workflow.description: The page shows the flow from saving a link to finding it again later.

save.title: 01. Enter a URL
save.description: Save public URLs such as articles, tools, videos, and app pages.

organize.title: 02. Add context
organize.description: Write why you kept the link so it makes sense when you come back.

discover.title: 03. Tag it
discover.description: Group related links with tags so they stay easy to follow.

access.title: 04. Find it again
access.description: Use the home page, search, and category views to revisit saved links.

categories.title: Browse by category
categories.description: Shared links arrive with different tags, languages, and levels of detail. Rito classifies them into a small, consistent set of topics so they remain easier to browse.
categories.input: Classification considers the page title and description first, then tags and the bookmarker's comment.
categories.result: Each bookmark receives one primary topic, such as Technology, Social, Food, Travel, Entertainment, Photo, or atproto.
categories.reason: Categories are a browsing aid, not an endorsement of the linked content or a statement about the author.

tags.title: Manual tags
tags.description: Tags are labels you add yourself. They let you group bookmarks around your own interests, projects, and ways of organizing.
tags.manual: Categories are assigned automatically, while tags are created and attached by you.
tags.use: Use tags for project names, reading queues, research topics, or any personal grouping.
tags.search: Tags make it easier to revisit bookmarks by your own labels and search habits.

search.title: Organize and search saved bookmarks
search.description: Rito helps you find saved links through automatic categories, tags, and filtering.
search.filterDescription: You can filter by exact tag or user handle, narrow results by mutual-follow relationships, and exclude conditions with a leading minus sign. Partial text search over link or comment bodies is not supported.

browser.title: Register from your browser
browser.description: Send the page you are viewing to Rito from your browser or bookmarks.

login.title: Sign in with your account
login.description: Rito uses PDS and OAuth to sign you in without receiving your password.

step1.title: Enter your handle
step1.description: Enter the handle you use for Bluesky or another atproto account.

step2.title: Authenticate on your PDS
step2.description: Rito redirects you to the connected PDS screen. Enter your password there; it is not sent to Rito.

step3.title: Approve access
step3.description: Review what Rito can read and write, then approve the request to finish signing in.

sync.title: Sync with Bluesky
sync.description: Rito works through the atproto network and can connect bookmark activity with Bluesky.
sync.shareDescription: When you register a bookmark, you can also post it to Bluesky so followers can see the link on their timeline.
sync.saveDescription: Register a Bluesky post URL in Rito to keep it as a bookmark and find it later with tags or categories.

start.title: Start using Rito
start.description: If you already have an atproto account, you can start social bookmarking without creating another account.
